fields.Name: T354 - Archive Config Entities Sub-Grid Add and Remove
fields.Description: Exercises the nested inline editable entities sub-grid (AddEntity/RemoveEntity mutating the in-memory ConfigEntities array) — a distinct code path from the top-level config list and from any generic grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and select 'Archiving'. On the 'Configuration' tab, select any configuration card (or click '+ Add Configuration' to create a draft). Scroll to the 'Entities' section within the detail panel and click its 'Add Entity' button. Success is seeing a new editable row appear in the Entities table with inputs/dropdowns for Entity name, Mode, Retention, Batch, Date Field, and an Active checkbox. Then click the trash/delete icon on that row and verify the row is removed from the table. Do NOT save. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Add Entity' inserts a new editable row into the Entities table with Entity/Mode/Retention/Batch/Date Field/Active controls
Clicking the row's trash/remove icon deletes that row from the table (row count returns to its prior state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
